newsitem.title: USA: F&M Bancorp sees Q4 restructuring charges.
newsitem.headline: F&M Bancorp sees Q4 restructuring charges.

text.p: F&M Bancorp said it will record restructuring charges amounting to about $771 thousand before taxes ($0.10 per share) in conjunction with its acquisition of Home Federal Corp.

It said the charges are largely related to employment agreements and the termination of a vendor contract. Other charges will include about $744 thousand before taxes ($0.08 per share) as a result of realigning Home Federal's loan and real estate owned portfolios within a newly established centralized credit policy.
Charges will be recorded in the quarter ending December 31.

F&M Bancorp reported that such customary costs associated with a merger of this size were anticipated and allow the company to move forward clearly focused on a full range of opportunities to enhance profitability.
